7. Revision history¶

7.1. Version 1.4¶

  • Added support for new switch types; Single side diamond crossing and double side diamond crossing.
  • Added pispec_configurator. Storing and documentation of instance and predicate rules and handling of the PiSPEC generation.
  • Various bug fixes.

7.2. Version 1.4.1¶

  • Bug fixes.

7.3. Version 1.4.2¶

  • Bug fixes.

7.4. Version 1.4.3¶

  • Added geo predicate ‘Positive(dirObj)’ and a corresponding built-in ‘g_positive’.
  • Fixed 2 bugs in the class ‘SwitchIter’ dealing with the corner case of paths beginning or ending in switch nodes.

7.5. Version 1.4.4¶

  • Added attributes for railyard node coordinates and for railyard objects contained in nodes.
  • Added automatic setting of the coordinate attribute for an object in a node, given that the node has its coordinate attribute set. This feature is implemented in ‘MutableRailyard’ which will be automatically used if the railyard is created using ‘railyard_import.fromLayoutEditor’ (the recommended way when using the layout editor).
  • Path shifting has been disabled (only used in the first modular project).
  • Now the railyard used when producing PiSPEC is stored in ‘CurrentRailyard’ in the ‘LayoutEditorAPI’.

7.6. Version 1.4.5¶

  • Fixed bug that prevented import of iLock_Geography in the T phase.

7.7. Version 1.4.6¶

  • Removed _GeoPredicatePathShift and refactor its subclasses.
  • Add functionality to distinguish start and end objects for paths when building the corresponding predicates.
  • Added documentation to geo_attributes, geo_type and type_manager.
  • Refactored geo_algorithm.py as a sub-package and added documentation.
  • Fixed the bugs in different modules.

7.8. Version 1.4.7¶

  • Add Constant, NthAreaInPath, Union and other predicates
  • Add several GeoPredicates to better support demo
  • Adding preliminary support for LCF flow
  • Add module lcf2pispec
  • Add a method to convert GeoPredicate to LCF table

7.9. Version 1.4.8¶

  • Remove redundant GeoPredicates from predicate library
  • Fixed typecheck errors

7.10. Version 1.4.9¶

  • Refactor out predicate_library as a package.
  • Documentation of public modules is done.
  • Minor issues fixed.

7.11. Version 1.4.10¶

  • Bugfix in orient_railyard function; now supports crossings.
  • Expose the restriction and edgCondition arguments of the NextObject predicate.
  • geo_algorithms.railyard:restrict can now optionally include areas that are intersecting the restriction, not only areas fully contained in the restriction.

7.12. Version 1.5¶

  • Add support for generating PiSPEC instances and populating predicates based on LCF2Tab.json, LCF2Ins.json and LCF2Par.json files. The lcf2pispec module has been deprecated.

7.13. Version 1.5.1¶

  • Bugfix for FilterProjectT; could not filter on columns containing railyard entities.
  • Use lcf_utils 1.0.1 to fix crash when parsing RJSON on systems with a .NET framework < 4.7.1

7.14. Version 1.5.2¶

  • Bug fix: Support dumping files containing non-ascii characters.

7.15. Version 1.6¶

  • Add support for using the default Types.lcf file loaded by Prover iLock.
  • Remove the unofficial crlf module.
  • Remove the unofficial xml module.
  • Add support for Prover iLock’s 2019 layout editor.
  • Bugfix: A parameter may only be specified once in LCF2Par.

7.16. Version 2.0¶

  • LCFWorkflow.run will no longer dump files to the “generated-lcf-files” in the project directory. Instead, the file contents are stored in Prover iLock’s persistent storage.

7.17. Version 2.0.1¶

  • Fixed bug where FilterProjectT failed to work if filterCols referred to a column with a nullable type.
  • Implemented stricter checking of the values of requiredValues in FilterProjectT.
  • There is now stricter type checking of filter tables, in order to provide better error messages.
  • There is now a better error message when a filter table has not been populated.
  • Fixed crash when FilterProjectT was used without specifying projectCols.

7.18. Version 2.1¶

  • Added table method FilterTypeProjectT.
  • Added table method InnerJoinT.
  • Added table method NextAreaInPathT.
  • PiSPEC instances generated with the LCF workflow are now always placed under their corresponding railyard instance in the project tree.

7.19. Version 2.1.1¶

  • Made the posOrient argument to NextObjectT optional, as specified in the LFC.
  • Python 3 compatibility

7.20. Version 2.2¶

  • Added support for the LCF2Inst-cfg-2.0 format. Instantiation rules are now stored in this format in Prover iLock’s persistent storage.
  • Added support for the LCF2Par-cfg-2.0 format. Parameter rules are now stored in this format in Prover iLock’s persistent storage.
  • Added rudimentary support for the LCF2Tab-cfg-2.0 format. Local table declarations and table method pipelines are not supported. Table rules are now stored in this format in Prover iLock’s persistent storage.
  • Added support for the LCF-2.0-packaga-data format. The type system is now stored in this format in Prover iLock’s persistent storage.
  • The minimal required Prover iLock version is now 5.11.1, in order to support LCF 2.0.
  • Upgrade lcf_utils to version 2.0

7.21. Version 3.0¶

  • The requiredValues argument of FilterProjectT has been renamed to conditions, in order to be compliant with the lcf2hll toolchain. This is a backwards incompatible change.
  • FilterProjectT can now be used to filter columns by regular expressions or by type.
  • FilterTypeProjectT has been removed in favor of FilterProjectT with kind=type.
  • The long deprecated lcf.lcf2pispec module has been removed.
  • The joinCols1 and joinCols2 arguments of InnerJoinT have been merged into a single joinCols argument. This is a backwards incompatible change. Likewise, projectCols now takes a list of two-element lists to specify the table to select the projection column from. Again, this change was made in order for compliance with the lcf2hll toolchain.

7.22. Version 4.0¶

  • The field “content” in LCF2Tab has been renamed to “methods”, in order to comply with the specification for the LCF2Tab-cfg-2.0 format.
  • The field “content” in LCF2Par has been renamed to “par-rules”, in order to comply with the specification for the LCF2Par-cfg-2.0 format.
  • The areaUserTypes of table method NextAreaInPathT is now mandatory in order to comply with lfd-lib.
  • Improved the error message for the error where a lcf table column used in lcf2par contains null values.

7.23. Version 5.0¶

  • Added support for integer parameters.
  • Added support for local table type declarations in LCF2Tab.
  • Added support for table method pipeines in LCF2Tab.
  • Added table method MatchT.
  • Implemented type containment check for parameters. This means that if a table with signature [lcf_type_a, lcf_type_b] is mapped on a PiSPEC parameter with signature [PiClassA, PiClassB], the check only passes if all instances of PiClassA originate from a lcf entity with type lcf_type_a (or a subtype of it), and all instances of PiClassB originate from a lcf entity with type lcf_type_b (or a subtype). This ensures the table may cover the entire domain of the parameter.
  • lcf.api.parseStoredLCF2Tab now returns an instance of LCF2TabConfig instead of a list of TabRule instances. This is a backwards incompatible change.
  • lcf.parse.PredRule has been renamed to ParRule. This is a backwards incompatible change.
  • All accessor methods of lcf.parse.InstRule, ParRule, TabRule, and TabFilter have been turned into properties instead of methods. This is a backwards incompatible change.

7.24. Version 5.0.1¶

  • Fixed misspelling of field “regexp” (it was incorrectly “regex”) in table method FilterProjectT.
  • Added the possibility to assign “ordinal” objects with a value in an attribute (for later translation into a LCF table)

7.25. Version 5.0.2¶

  • Updated lcf_utils version.

7.26. Version 5.1¶

  • Made it possible to implement custom table methods operating on other tables. This is achieved by:
    • adding an optional hook method validateAgainstPackageData which can be used to obtain type information for tables in the system.
    • adding a helper method getTable for reading the contents of a LCF table.
    • exposing lcf.table_methods.getTableSig for getting the signature of a table.
  • Fixed a bug in how boundary nodes were calculated for the ObjectInAreaT table method. This only affects uses of ObjectInAreaT where the innerStrict argument is used.

7.27. Version 5.2¶

  • Made the Path Generator API more consistent. It is now possible to call the method generate of all Path Generator classes without any arguments. Rather, the same arguments can be supplied to the constructor instead.

7.28. Version 5.2.1¶

  • Bugfix; now also DirObj2EndPaths can be used without giving arguments to the generate method.
